Plasmid Assistant - early portable prototype

Keep this entire folder together, including _internal and local_features.json.
Double-click PlasmidAssistant.exe. No separate Python or Ollama installation is
needed by this executable. You can place the folder in your SnapGene installation
or another location. Delete this folder to remove the assistant.

1. Open sequence: choose SnapGene .dna, GenBank, or FASTA.
2. Analyze: processing can pause the window while matching runs.
3. Highlight candidate rows and click Toggle selected to accept or reject them.
   Existing annotations remain preserved. Unknown ORFs start unselected.
4. Export to a NEW .gb file, then open that file in SnapGene.

The assistant does not modify SnapGene or overwrite original sequence files.
SnapGene-specific display settings, history, and other proprietary document
metadata are not carried into GenBank. Export is GenBank only.

Current limits: small local reference set; exact and full-length substitution
matching only; no partial or insertion/deletion alignment; heuristic confidence;
no independently validated real-plasmid accuracy benchmark. The local database
was extracted from this installation: do not assume redistribution rights.

Verified here: executable launches, real .dna imports, sequence and 12 existing
annotations round-trip, one removed origin is recovered, source file unchanged.
That recovery used a reference-source construct, not an independent benchmark.
Clean Windows machine without Python testing remains pending.
